fieldrepairs_husk_customization_desc: Alive checks in CharacterCustomization:_part_loaded_callback. Prevents an engine crash when a joiner aborts while the husk is spawned.
fieldrepairs_mission_script_queue_desc: Cheap callback queue for mission scripts. Fixes frametime spikes in maps with many polling elements (Odin's Fall). Applies from the next raid.
fieldrepairs_world_leak_desc: Lets go of what a destroyed mission world still holds. Saves 10-20 MB of Lua heap per raid that is started and left.
fieldrepairs_waypoint_desc: Skips waypoints that have neither a position nor a living unit instead of raising a Lua error.
fieldrepairs_portal_units_desc: Removes units from portal unit groups when their id is removed, so removed units are not kept.
fieldrepairs_attention_corpses_desc: Skips corpses and friendly units in enemy detection. Big speedup in large fights.
